gaps.help: Write [[1]], [[2]], … in the question text where the gaps go: [[n]] is a gap whose right answer is choice n. A gap offers the choices of its right choice’s group.

cloze.help: Write the gaps into the question text, as in Moodle (examples below): a weight, the TYPE and the answers. = marks the right answer, %50% a half-right one, # starts feedback and ~ separates answers. TYPE is SHORTANSWER (SA), SHORTANSWER_C (case sensitive), NUMERICAL (NM, number:tolerance), MULTICHOICE (MC a list, MCV vertical, MCH horizontal) or MULTIRESPONSE (MR, MRH); add S to shuffle the choices (MCS, MRS). Escape a closing brace, # and ~ with a backslash.

calc.help: Answers are formulas of variables written in braces, as in Moodle (examples below). Each variable takes its values from a dataset: every attempt draws one variant. Write variables in the question text too; a formula after = in braces shows a worked-out value.
calc.multiHelp: Each choice is a text in which a formula after = in braces shows a worked-out value (examples below); variables take their values from datasets, one variant per attempt.

badges.imageHint: PNG or SVG up to 1 MB, preferably square
badges.locked: The badge has been awarded: its criteria and expiry stay as they are.

expiryChoice.days: This many days after it is awarded

badges.archiveConfirm: The badge will no longer be awarded; awards already given stay valid.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.myIntro: The certificates issued to you. Anyone can check the code on a certificate on the verification page.
certificates.name: Name
certificates.onCompletion: Issue when the course is completed
certificates.backgroundHint: PNG or JPEG up to 5 MB, stretched over the whole page
certificates.previewNote: The page ({w}×{h} mm) roughly; the PDF is exact.
certificates.fieldsHint: Coordinates are in millimetres from the top left corner: X is the left end, middle or right end of the line (as aligned), Y the top of the first line. Size is in points; with a width above zero the text wraps.
certificates.onCompletionNote: Issued on course completion and by hand
certificates.archiveConfirm: The certificate will no longer be issued; those issued stay valid.
certificates.noIssues: The certificate has not been issued yet
certificates.issueByHandHint: By hand it can be issued to any learner of the course, even one who has not completed it, and a revoked one issued again.
certificates.verifyIntro: Enter the code from a certificate to see whom it was issued to, for what, and whether it stands.
certificates.badCode: A code is 12 letters and digits: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

competencies.name: Name
competencies.newScale: A new scale “Not yet competent, Competent”
competencies.emptyFramework: The framework has no competencies yet
competencies.ruleNeedsChildren: A rule is set on a competency with children.

competencies.cohortsHint: Every member gets a plan from the template: now, and hourly for new members.
competencies.noCourseCompetencies: The course has no competencies yet
competencies.pushRatings: Ratings in the course rate the learner's competencies (and their learning plans)
competencies.plansIntro: The competencies being worked on, and their ratings.

confirmStep.complete: The plan keeps its competencies' ratings as they are now.
confirmStep.unapprove: The plan goes back to draft.

competencies.unlinkConfirm: The plan stops following the template and keeps its competencies as its own.
competencies.completeNote: The plan is complete: the ratings shown are those it was completed with.
